name: smwmusic-ghouls-n-ghosts-amiga-title-screen
title: Ghouls 'n Ghosts (Amiga) - Title Screen
description:
Acoustic guitar-heavy title screen music from the Amiga version of Ghouls 'n Ghosts.

The custom loop version is made in order for the song to loop smoothly, being intended for levels, and it's slightly smaller than the full version (0x0739 bytes). The full version is more for cutscenes and whatnot.

In the full version's text files, there is a #define LOOPABLE. It's set to 1 by default, and when it's set to 0, it will not loop back to the beginning at all, it'll just be still when the song comes to an end.

Incompatible with @7 (bonus end fanfare) and thunder sound effect.
The full version will omit one of the samples under the following defines:
-#define P_SWITCH 1 will enable P-Switch sample and omit Yoshi sample.
-#define P_SWITCH 0 (or other number) will be vice versa.

UPDATE: Corrected a few notes, as well as updating the overdriven guitar sample.
